propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Infirmitatem nostram respice, omnipotens Deus: et, quia pondus propriae
actionis gravat, beati N. Martyris tui atque Pontificis intercessio gloriosa
nos protegat. Per Dominum.

Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Hostias tibi, Domine, beati N. Martyris tui atque Pontificis dicatas
meritis, benignus assume: et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat
in unitate.

translations.caution: Original study translation; not approved for liturgical use or recitation.
translations.text: Graciously accept, Lord, the sacrifices dedicated to you in honor of the merits of blessed N., your Martyr and Bishop, and grant that they may provide us with lasting help. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who lives and reigns with you in unity.
